bonusLetter.selectionRule: Each time a letter is added while bonusball == -1: bonusrnd = random(bonusrange=1000); if (bonusrnd < bonusmin=50) bonusball = kelime.length, so the ball at that 0-based index (the next letter added) becomes the bonus ball (5% per added letter). A valid submit scores +5000 while bonusball > -1; removing the bonus ball or clearing a non-empty entry resets bonusball to -1.
